why: E8-ic3-scale was delivered by W-1660 on this branch and logged DONE at 2026-07-29T12:16:28Z, then reappeared on the board and was claimed three more times (W-1671, --help, W-130). This run does not redo the measurement. It (a) independently verifies the delivered branch, (b) closes the deliverable's own stated gap 6 -- ENGINE_TABLE.md's ic3_pdr row still says the E8 ladder does not exist -- which could only be done after master's engine_table generator was in the tree, and (c) reports the board resurrection to monitor.

steps.finding: The re-issue is spurious, not a re-open. The reissued item file is byte-identical to the done copy (blob 2f773ec47c3b215ae126b29b6f5f6dd1aee110b5 = HEAD:monitor/board/items/E8-ic3-scale.md = monitor/board/done/E8-ic3-scale.W-1660.md). board.py moves items with os.rename in the working tree only and nobody commits the move, so HEAD still lists E8 as an available item; `git log --all -- monitor/board/done/E8-ic3-scale.W-1660.md` returns zero commits. A pull --rebase/reset/ff-pull sequence at 10:18-10:29Z re-materialised items/E8-ic3-scale.md and rolled back board.log, erasing the CLAIM..W-1660 line; the 12:16Z DONE then freed the engine-rig territory and the resurrected item became claimable. Second necessary condition: board.py candidates() (:139,:148) uses done_ids() only to resolve deps and never skips an item whose own id is already done.
steps.consequence: This item is not new work. Scope becomes: independently verify the delivered branch, land it, and close the gaps the deliverable itself states.

steps.verdict: 'fully delivered' is REFUTED. The machinery is real -- 235 tests pass, `document --check` exits 0, `ic3bounds.verify` exits 0 on both run dirs, all 19 MANIFEST sha256s verify, worldgen is import-only, and the sealed pile is untouched (no sealed game id appears anywhere in the diff). What fails is coverage and document/artifact drift.
